title: One tenant schema in a deploy fan-out
caption: packages/db/src/migrate/tenants.ts. Every target ends in exactly one list of the report; the run exits 3 when failed / total > max-failure-ratio (default 0.1: 1 of 10 passes, 1 of 3 does not).

states.label: Migrating (own connection, advisory xact lock on the schema)
applied[] (now at target)
states.detail: Lists the files this run applied; none on a re-run.

states.label: skipped[]
states.detail: A provisioning tenant whose schema does not exist yet: provisioning applies every file.

states.label: failed[]
states.detail: Failing file (or null for a lock timeout), SQLSTATE, exitCode 2 for a checksum mismatch. Active/suspended without a schema also fails.
